snippet.title: 🎮 SOS (1979) - Classic Arcade Rescue Game
snippet.description:
🔹 About the Game:
SOS is a 1979 arcade game that challenges players to navigate treacherous waters and rescue stranded survivors. This early action game tests reflexes and precision as players control a rescue ship, avoiding obstacles while saving as many people as possible. A rare and unique title from the golden age of arcade gaming! 🚢🌊
